templates.1_cod_verification_immediate:
Hey {{customer_name}}! 👋 Thank you for choosing Snagged! 🚀 We received your Cash on Delivery order ({{order_id}}) for the Snagged™ 360° AI Auto-Tracker (₹1,999).

📍 Delivery to:
{{delivery_address}}, {{city}} ({{pincode}})

To ensure our courier team dispatches your package immediately, please reply with *'CONFIRM'*.

_(Note: If unconfirmed within 24 hrs, order will be automatically cancelled)._
templates.2_cod_verified_success: Awesome, {{customer_name}}! 🎉 Your order {{order_id}} is confirmed and sent to our fulfillment hub. You'll receive your tracking details once dispatched. Thank you for supporting Snagged!
templates.4_out_for_delivery_alert:
Knock knock! 🔔 {{customer_name}}, your Snagged package is OUT FOR DELIVERY today by {{courier_name}} executive ({{driver_phone}}).

💰 Amount to pay: ₹1,999 (Cash or GPay/PhonePe/Paytm accepted).

Please make sure someone is available at your address.
templates.5_delivery_attempt_failed:
Hi {{customer_name}}, the delivery executive attempted to deliver your Snagged package today but couldn't reach you. ⚠️

They will re-attempt tomorrow. Please reply to this message if you need us to change the delivery time or update your landmark.
templates.7_rto_cancellation_warning: Hi {{customer_name}}, our courier has made 2 attempts to deliver your package at {{city}}. If not accepted tomorrow, the order will be returned to hub. Please confirm if you still want it: Reply YES or NO.
templates.8_return_replacement_request:
Hello {{customer_name}}, we're sorry to hear you're experiencing an issue. As per our 7-day replacement policy, please share:
1. A short unboxing or working video showing the issue.
2. A photo of the shipping label on the box.
Our technical team will review and approve a free replacement within 24 hours.
templates.9_delayed_order_update: Hi {{customer_name}}, update on your order {{order_id}}: Due to local transit delays, your delivery is slightly delayed by 24-48 hours. Your new expected delivery date is {{new_date}}. We apologize for the wait!
templates.10_prepaid_discount_offer: Hey {{customer_name}}! Save ₹100 on your order {{order_id}}! Pay online via UPI (GPay/PhonePe) right now for ₹1,899 instead of ₹1,999 COD. Reply *'UPI'* to get the direct payment link.
templates.11_wrong_address_clarification: Hi {{customer_name}}, the courier team reported that your address is incomplete (missing house number or street name). Could you please reply with your exact full address and landmark?
templates.12_customer_support_greeting: Hi! You've reached Snagged Customer Support. How can we help you today with your order or product inquiries?
